candidates.description: This vector represents German auxiliary, modal, and common finite verbs primarily inflected in past and present tenses.
This vector represents narrative elements, characters, and dramatic roles within storytelling.
This feature vector represents adverbial intensifiers and quantifiers across multiple languages that modify the degree or extent of adjectives and verbs.
This feature vector represents quantifiers and words denoting indefinite quantities or plural amounts across multiple languages.
This vector is related to written and cinematic creative works, such as books, films, and novels across multiple languages.
This vector represents human beings categorized by age, life stage, or family relationship.
These tokens function as conjunctive adverbs and discourse markers used to indicate addition, consequence, or logical transition between clauses.
This feature vector activates strongly for characters, locations, and terminology associated with the Harry Potter fantasy universe.
This vector is related to common present and past tense verbs and auxiliary verbs.
This feature vector represents violent conflict and passionate, destructive human struggles.
